reason: The batch report behind the QR code and the known 200 mg dose are what I normally have to dig for, and a first box at $24.99 is a cheap way to try it. Counted capsules would be easy on my work trips.
objection: A foil sachet for every single day is a lot of packaging waste, and a brand new product on TikTok Shop has no reviews yet for me to read.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the real lab report for a batch before I pay, plus a few honest reviews from people who finished the 30 days.
